svg.title: ImageJAI agent command flow across CLI, TCP server, and Fiji
svg.desc: Three-column architecture diagram showing the order of components when an agent command is sent through ij.py to ImageJAI and Fiji, plus the separate event subscription channel.
svg.text: ImageJAI command flow: agent to Fiji and back
Solid arrows are request/response. Dotted arrows are event subscription frames or local helper-only work. The middle column is the part most agents do not see directly.

g.text: CLI agent + workspace
terminal, helper scripts, local docs, caches
ImageJAI JVM socket server
TCPCommandServer on loopback localhost:7746
Fiji / ImageJ runtime
actual image analysis state and plugin work
Agent context files
agent/CLAUDE.md, agent/AGENTS.md, agent/GEMINI.md
House rules: check state, probe plugins, save to AI_Exports.
Agent-facing commands and helpers
python agent/ij.py macro|script|groovy|jython|subscribe
from ij import get_state, run_script, get_pixels, ...
CLI words are local aliases. ij.py converts them into JSON TCP
commands such as execute_macro, run_script, or subscribe.
Some typed commands are Python-only workflows after data is fetched.
ij.py transport layer
imagej_command(cmd) -> socket.connect(host, port)
json.dumps(cmd) + "\\n" -> sendall() -> read JSON reply
Hello/caps: session_id, model_endpoint, output format,
vision, state_delta, accepted event topics, optional token.
Readonly dedup cache: if_none_match for state, image info,
results, histogram, windows, metadata, dialogs, jobs.
agent/.tmp/ij_client_cache.json
Other Python helpers agents use
pixels.py: calls get_pixels, then decodes float32 pixels and
computes stats, profiles, stack summaries, bright objects locally.
probe_plugin.py: calls probe_command and caches discovered dialog
parameters so agents do not repeatedly open the same plugin.
auditor.py: reads results/image metadata through ij.py and audits
tables locally for unit, calibration, bit-depth, and table issues.
All stable workflows are importable via __all__ and tested.
Local planning data
recipes/*.yaml: reusable workflow recipes.
references/*.md: microscopy and ImageJ knowledge base.
agent/.tmp/plugin_args: plugin probe cache.
These guide command choice but do not control Fiji by themselves.
Agent receives structured feedback
One-shot calls return one JSON object: ok/result/error plus deltas.
Subscriptions stream newline-delimited frames until disconnected.
1. TCP listener accepts a loopback socket
ServerSocket bound to localhost. Each normal connection sends one UTF-8 newline-terminated JSON request.
Oversized request lines are rejected before parsing.
2. Fast split: is this command subscribe?
subscribe is intercepted before the normal dispatcher because it upgrades the socket into a long-lived stream.
3A. handleSubscribeStream
Parse topics; default topic is "*".
Register EventBus listener for exact, *, or suffix wildcard.
Max subscribers: 8. Per-socket queue: 256 frames.
Overflow drops oldest and emits event_dropped.
Heartbeat frame every 30s of idle time.
{"event","data","ts","seq"} + "\\n"
3B. JSON parse, caps, auth
JsonParser builds a JsonObject request.
hello negotiates AgentCaps and optional token auth.
dispatchInternal records command history for friction and hints.
Token gate can reject non-hello/non-ping commands.
Socket caps decide response shape: stateDelta, pulse,
histogramDelta, graphDelta, governance, dedup.
4. dispatchCore routes command name to handlers
Connection/read: hello, ping, list_commands, get_state, get_image_info, get_results_table, get_log, get_console.
Image data: get_histogram, get_open_windows, get_metadata, get_pixels, get_roi_state, get_display_state, get_image_graph.
Execution: execute_macro, run_script, run_pipeline, explore_thresholds, batch, run, 3d_viewer, open_image, capture_image.
UI/plugin: get_dialogs, close_dialogs, close_windows, probe_command, interact_dialog, gui_action, request_visual.
Async/reactive: execute_macro_async, job_status, job_cancel, job_list, list_reactive_rules, reactive_enable/disable/reload/stats.
Governance/state history: intent*, friction*, ledger_lookup/confirm, rewind, branch, branch_list/switch/delete.
Several CLI commands collapse to one handler; batch/run recursively dispatch generated command objects.
5. Execution bridge and guardrails
execute_macro uses CommandEngine / IJ.runMacro.
run_script uses ScriptEngineManager: groovy, jython, javascript.
MACRO_MUTEX and macroInFlight serialize ImageJ-global state.
Dialog polling catches blocking GenericDialogs and may auto-dismiss.
Snapshots collect results, images, histograms, graph, undo boundary.
SessionCodeJournal records macro/script source and outcome.
6. Response decoration and writeback
Handler returns JsonObject with success, result, output, or error.
Post-processing adds redaction/governance, audit receipt, dedup hash,
friction log entries, pattern hints, stateDelta, histogramDelta,
graphDelta, pulse, or phantomDialog if enabled.
writeOutbound(command, JSON + "\\n")
7. EventBus side channel inside the same JVM
Singleton pub/sub bus. Publishers call publish(topic, data); subscribers match exact, *, image.*, etc.
Frames include monotonic seq and timestamp. Same-topic events are coalesced for 200 ms.
macro.*, image.*, dialog.*, results.changed, job.*, safe_mode.*, data_governance.*, gui_action.*, memory.pressure.
Suppression scopes can temporarily hide image.* events during sensitive macro execution.
This does not execute commands by itself; it tells agents what changed so they can decide the next TCP request.
Fiji execution engines
ImageJ macro interpreter: IJ.runMacro and IJ.run commands.
JSR-223 script engines: Groovy, Jython, JavaScript when present.
Command registry/menu commands are what probe_command inspects.
EDT/Swing constraints still apply to UI-facing work.
Image and measurement state
WindowManager, ImagePlus, stacks, channels, slices, calibration.
Pixel data for get_pixels is serialized as base64 float32.
ResultsTable, ROI Manager, overlays, histograms, metadata.
ImageGraph tracks derived images created by macro/script runs.
Read handlers inspect this state; mutating handlers change it.
Deltas summarize what changed since the command started.
Dialogs, windows, plugins
GenericDialog and Swing windows can be listed, filled, clicked,
focused, or closed through interact_dialog and gui_action.
Plugin examples: Bio-Formats, MorphoLibJ, StarDist, TrackMate,
CLIJ2/GPU, Trainable Weka, 3D Viewer, and local lab plugins.
Log window, stdout/stderr buffers, progress bar, and open windows
are read back by get_log, get_console, get_progress, state calls.
Plugins do not know the agent exists; they just see normal Fiji use.
Event publishers
CommandEngine: macro.started, macro.completed, results.changed.
ImageMonitor: image.opened, image.closed, image.updated, memory.pressure.
DialogWatcher: dialog.appeared, dialog.closed.
JobRegistry: job.started/progress/completed/failed.
PostureController and ReactiveEngine publish governance/rule events.
Files and visible artifacts
AI_Exports/ next to the opened image: captures, reports, exports.
imagejai_audit.csv records command receipts when auditing is active.
Session journal stores macro and script code run over TCP.
Visual request/capture commands create inspectable image artifacts.
These outputs are how agents leave durable analysis evidence.
normal request/response control path
streaming event or local helper path
agent-side Python and docs
ImageJAI JVM broker, dispatcher, event bus, response shaping
Fiji/ImageJ runtime, plugins, windows, images, files
